name: Relationship-Economy Underwriting Framework
notice: The National Edition publishes questions and evidence prompts, not company scores.

dimensions.name: Relationship dependency
dimensions.definition: How much customer value depends on trusted human relationships rather than information access alone?
evidence_prompts: Share of interaction that is facilitated or curated

dimensions.name: Access scarcity
dimensions.definition: How difficult is it for a competitor or software product to reproduce access to the relevant people?
evidence_prompts: Time required to build the network

dimensions.name: Community density
dimensions.definition: How frequently and meaningfully do members interact across the network?

dimensions.name: Trust dependency
dimensions.definition: Does candor, confidentiality or reputation materially affect the product's value?

dimensions.name: Recurring revenue
dimensions.definition: How much revenue is contracted, subscribed or predictably repeated?

dimensions.name: Proprietary data generation
dimensions.definition: Does participation generate exclusive, permissioned or difficult-to-replicate data?

dimensions.name: In-person experience value
dimensions.definition: How much value is created by physical presence, serendipity and real-time interaction?

dimensions.name: Content automation exposure
dimensions.definition: How much of the offer can generative systems reproduce without access to the network?

dimensions.name: Sponsor concentration
dimensions.definition: How dependent is the model on a small number of commercial partners or sponsors?

dimensions.name: Key-person dependency
dimensions.definition: Could the product retain trust and participation without its founder or a small group of conveners?

dimensions.name: Operational scalability
dimensions.definition: Can the platform add members, geographies or programs without proportional cost growth or loss of quality?

dimensions.name: Acquisition potential
dimensions.definition: Can the platform compound through adjacent communities, data products or event brands?
